topic: What is Logistics Management? - Camcode · Part 1/4

passage.text: Inbound logistics relates to the incoming transportation and storage of raw materials, components, and other supplies needed to manufacture a finished product. It is a crucial part of overall logistics management. If a company fails to acquire the necessary materials, manufacturing operations can be delayed, which ultimately results in backorders and unhappy customers. Inbound logistics processes must therefore be coordinated closely with procurement. This coordination helps to ensure that the transportation and storage needed to move and store materials are available as they arrive.
